source_caption:
🎬 The Hustle (2019)

The Hustle follows Josephine Chesterfield and Penny Rust, two clever but completely different con artists who make their living by tricking wealthy men out of their money. Josephine is a sophisticated and glamorous British scammer who operates in the luxurious French Riviera, using her elegance, intelligence, and elaborate schemes to manipulate wealthy targets. Penny, on the other hand, is a loud, unpredictable, and street-smart American hustler whose unconventional methods often create hilarious situations. When their paths cross, the two women initially clash over their competing approaches to deception. However, their rivalry quickly develops into an outrageous competition to determine who is the better con artist. As they attempt increasingly ridiculous scams involving elaborate disguises, romantic manipulation, and unexpected twists, both discover that their greatest challenge may be outsmarting each other. Combining sharp comedy, glamorous settings, clever deception, and entertaining performances, the film explores ambition, rivalry, confidence, friendship, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to outsmart everyone around you.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Crime

⭐ IMDb: 5.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 34m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Chris Addison

🏆 Recognition: Starring Anne Hathaway, Rebel Wilson, Alex Sharp, and Ingrid Oliver, the film is a female-led remake of the 1988 comedy Dirty Rotten Scoundrels. Known for its glamorous French Riviera setting, elaborate scams, physical comedy, and the contrasting comedic styles of Hathaway and Wilson, it earned approximately $97 million worldwide.

source_details.synopsis: The Hustle is a 2019 American comedy film directed by Chris Addison, starring Anne Hathaway, Rebel Wilson, and Alex Sharp. It was written by Stanley Shapiro, Paul Henning, Dale Launer, and Jac Schaeffer. It is a female-led remake of the 1988 film Dirty Rotten Scoundrels, which is a remake of the 1964 film Bedtime Story. The film follows two women who set out to con an Internet millionaire. The film was theatrically released in the United States on May 10, 2019, by United Artists Releasing, and internationally distributed by Universal Pictures. It received negative reviews from critics and grossed $97 million worldwide.
